title: Initials Story · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Initials Story · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose three letters in a fixed order. The lead makes a sensible three-word phrase whose words begin with those letters in order. The phrase follows the initial letters and can be understood. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Initials Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The phrase follows the initial letters and can be understood.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The phrase follows the initial letters and can be understood.
